items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Gladys was my wife – first wife

ctx.x: I think at some point, you – how old were you when you got married?
19, I think. John and Gladys married October 22, 1932; John was 20 years old.
Can you tell us about meeting Gladys?
